text: Democratic elections translate votes into representation. Voters register, then cast ballots for candidates or measures. Plurality systems award each seat to the top vote-getter. Proportional systems divide seats by vote share. Districts, boundaries, and turnout shape outcomes as much as preferences. Free press, independent courts, and trusted counting underpin legitimacy. L…
